    Add discountType to coupons (regresses on legacy coupons)
    
    October 2026 migration: coupons now carry a discountType ('PERCENTAGE' |
    'FIXED') so we can support fixed dollar-off coupons. calculateDiscount now
    reads coupon.discountType.
    
    Regression: legacy coupons created before the migration have no discountType,
    so calculateDiscount throws a TypeError for them. The test suite still passes
    because it only covers new coupons. See src/reproduceLegacyBug.ts.
